name: Approve and post Slack expense receipts to Xero with Textract and OpenAI

parameters.content:
## Expense Receipt Approval (Slack -> Textract -> Manager Approval -> Xero)

### How it works

This workflow starts when a receipt image is posted in Slack, verifies that it is an image, and uses AWS Textract plus GPT to extract, categorize, normalize, and validate the expense details. Valid receipts are routed to the employee’s manager for Slack approval, while unclear submissions receive a request for a better photo. Approved expenses are converted into either a Xero bill or expense claim, the receipt is attached to the Xero record, and the outcome is logged; rejected expenses are also notified and logged.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Slack Trigger with the correct workspace, app permissions, event subscription, and channel or file-upload source for receipt images.
- Add AWS credentials with permission to run Textract AnalyzeExpense on uploaded receipt files.
- Configure OpenAI credentials for the GPT categorization step and review the prompt/category mapping used by the node.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and prepare sheets for manager lookup plus approved/rejected audit logging with the expected columns.
- Configure Xero API/OAuth access for the HTTP Request nodes, including tenant ID, authorization headers, account codes, tax rates, and endpoints for bills, expense claims, and attachments.
- Verify the custom Code nodes preserve required fields such as employee, amount, date, merchant, category, Slack file binary data, and Xero record IDs across branches.

### Customization

Adjust the validation rules, GPT expense categories, manager lookup sheet, approval message format, and the switch logic that decides whether an approved item becomes a Xero bill or an expense claim.

## Capture Slack receipt

Receives new Slack activity and filters the incoming item so only receipt image uploads continue into processing.

## Extract receipt fields

Runs AWS Textract AnalyzeExpense on the receipt image and parses the returned OCR expense fields into structured data.

## Categorize and normalize

Uses GPT to classify the expense, then merges AI output with extracted receipt data into a normalized record for downstream checks.

## Validate and request approval

Checks whether the receipt data is complete enough to proceed, asks the submitter for a clearer photo when validation fails, or looks up the manager and sends a Slack approval request when valid.

## Prepare Xero routing

Loads the approved expense context and decides whether the approved item should be handled as a Xero expense claim or a bill.

## Create Xero record

Creates the appropriate financial record in Xero, either an expense claim or a bill, based on the routing decision.

## Attach receipt and log

Restores the receipt binary, attaches the image to the created Xero record, and records the approved transaction in Google Sheets.

## Handle rejected expenses

Sends a Slack rejection notification and logs the rejected expense in Google Sheets in a separate lower branch of the canvas.
